'''Seyugi''' was an astronomical object located in the [[Seyugi system/Legends|Seyugi system]] of the [[Arrowhead]], a region in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Seyugi fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] around [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

The celestial body shared its name with the [[Seyugi (culture)|Seyugi]], a culture that at one point existed on the Core Worlds [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Recopia]].<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> At some point by [[980 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' is presented as a collection of [[in-universe]] writings, including ''[[The Rule of Two]]'', which mentions the [[Seyugi Dervish]]es and was [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. Since Bane's [[Duel on Ambria (990 BBY)|death]] was depicted in ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', the events of which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[980 BBY]], the Seyugi Dervishes must have been formed by that date.</ref> the Seyugi people gave rise to<ref name="JATM" /> the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-using]] cult of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] known as the [[Seyugi Dervish]]es.<ref name="Coruscant">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> Eventually, the Seyugi Dervishes spread throughout the Core<ref name="JATM" /> and established a presence on the astronomical object Seyugi.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Seyugi was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-11.<ref name="TEA" />
